statement: Replace negative inference from one fixed witness by an exact admissible source-family interface. Define a coefficient/category-safe family of algebraic-cycle/Chow/K0 representatives realizing α and determine conditions under which Hodge-branch directions or points are reached by some source while preserving enough boundedness/properness/component control to support compatible higher-order lifting. Do not infer one fixed witness, one component, or algebraization without a separate bridge.

first_order_quantifier_profile.fixed_witness_target: exists w0 such that for every v in T_s0 T there exists a tangent lift at w0
first_order_quantifier_profile.source_family_directional_target: for every v in T_s0 T there exists an admissible w_v over s0 and a tangent lift at w_v
first_order_quantifier_profile.warning: the first target implies the second; the converse is an unsupported quantifier swap without extra source structure

required_subobligations: admissible representative category for finite signed rational cycles or a justified rational Chow/K0 replacement
source-family completeness: no relevant representative/component is silently excluded
boundedness/quasi-compactness/properness or another mechanism controlling infinitely many source components
difference between tangent reachability, source-component dominance, and pointwise fiber nonemptiness
higher-Artin compatible component choice rather than direction-wise unrelated witnesses
positive_controls: Kloosterman special complete-intersection hypersurface family: explicit fixed flag-Hilbert geometry
Bloch–Esnault–Kerz: rational K0 formal deformation under stated Chow–Künneth hypotheses, with algebraization explicitly separate
falsifier: A proposed closure fails if it only proves a detector vanishes, only handles one arbitrary fixed witness and then draws source-complete negative conclusions, loses rational signed coefficients, uses an infinite union of source images without a boundedness/gluing argument, or treats formal K0 lifting as algebraization.
